summary: Not as a standalone entry. No Market Structure setting beat random entries pooled across BTC, ETH and SOL on 1h or 4h. CHoCH, BoS and bullish structure did the same as random on every timeframe where they could be judged. The closest result is price crossing up through a high on 4h BTC, which beat random by 0.55% and held without its strongest stretch.

verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. On 1h, 1,997 entries landed 0.03% ahead of random entries, inside the luck band.
Same as random pooled on 1h, 4h and daily. On 4h the result split by trend, but each side rests on a single candle.

verdicts.text: Internal and swing bullish BoS did the same as random on 1h and 4h, and internal BoS did too on daily. Swing BoS on daily fired too rarely to judge.

verdicts.text: Same as random pooled on 1h and 4h. On daily it beat random by 3%, but only because of three signals between Aug 6, 2021 and Aug 27, 2021. Without them, it was the same as random.

verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, pooled across the pairs. Its splits by trend show at 20 candles only.

notes: An internal bullish CHoCH on 1h gave 1,997 entries in 1,950 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.03% ahead of random entries, inside the luck band. On 4h it fires about a quarter as often and lands in the same place. Shorting the internal bearish CHoCH did the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily.

On 1h, internal bullish BoS fires about six and a half times as often as swing bullish BoS. Neither left the luck band on 1h or 4h. Internal BoS on daily was 4.79% ahead of random, still inside the band, and swing BoS on daily gave only 13 moves, too few to judge. Downtrend signals were too few to judge for swing BoS on 4h and daily, and for internal BoS on daily.

Bullish market structure is a state, so it enters on every candle it holds. On 1h its 86,521 entries collapse into 275 independent moves, 0.04% ahead of random. It stayed inside the band in both uptrends and downtrends on 1h and 4h. On daily, the 2,526 entries form only 11 moves, too few to judge in either trend.

Price crossing up through any high comes closest. On 4h BTC it beat random by 0.55%, held without its strongest stretch, and showed at 10 and 100 candles but not at 50. Pooled across the pairs on 4h, the 0.65% uptrend result rested on signals between Aug 10, 2021 and Aug 18, 2021, while in downtrends it was 0.01% from random. On daily, the uptrend result rested on three signals between Aug 6, 2021 and Aug 27, 2021, and downtrends showed nothing.

Several of the splits by trend rest on a single candle. Shorting a 4h bearish CHoCH beat random in uptrends because of one signal on May 16, 2021. It did worse than random in downtrends because of one signal on Jan 11, 2023. On daily, the downtrend short beat random only because of a signal on Nov 8, 2022, during the FTX collapse. Going long on a cross down through a low beat random in 1h uptrends and 4h downtrends at 20 candles, but not at 10, 50 or 100.

For a long DCA bot on these pairs, a CHoCH or BoS start condition timed entries no better than a random candle, so the DCA orders and take profit carry the result. Bullish market structure as a filter did not change the outcome on 1h or 4h, which makes it a setting you can leave out. The cross up through a high on 4h BTC is the one cell worth testing as a filter beside other conditions. It breaks once the pair falls below its 200-day SMA, where it showed nothing.
